findings.description: All entity tables (project, feature, session, learning) missing userId column. API routers pass context.session.user.id but column does not exist in schema or migrations.
findings.impact: Runtime failure on any authenticated create operation
findings.suggested_fix: Add userId column to all entity schemas with NOT NULL constraint and FK to auth user table, generate new migration

findings.description: getNextId() reads MAX(id), parses, increments without atomic lock. Concurrent creates produce duplicate IDs.
findings.impact: Duplicate primary keys under concurrent load, constraint violations crash API
findings.suggested_fix: Wrap in transaction with retry logic on constraint violation, or use database sequence

findings.description: calculateDuration() calls .getTime() assuming Date objects but may receive integer timestamps
findings.impact: Runtime TypeError when calculating session duration
findings.suggested_fix: Add defensive type check: value instanceof Date ? value.getTime() : value

findings.description: All empty criteria filtered to [], backend rejects min(1) but frontend passes
findings.impact: Confusing UX: form appears valid but backend rejects
findings.suggested_fix: Check filteredCriteria.length > 0 before submission, show toast if empty

findings.description: No client-side validation for title(5-80) and description(20-500) length constraints
findings.impact: Backend rejection after form appears valid
findings.suggested_fix: Add length validation in handleSave before mutation

findings.description: Closing panel via click-outside does not reset edit state; stale values persist on reopen
findings.impact: User may accidentally submit incorrect changes from stale state
findings.suggested_fix: Add useEffect cleanup that resets edit state when panel closes

findings.description: VALID_TRANSITIONS state machine redefined locally in tests instead of importing from @nomos-ai/types
findings.impact: Tests may pass against stale rules while production uses updated rules
findings.suggested_fix: Import FEATURE_VALID_TRANSITIONS from @nomos-ai/types

findings.description: Settings cast to Record<string, unknown> loses Zod validation chain
findings.impact: Type safety bypassed, arbitrary data can reach database
findings.suggested_fix: Create proper ProjectSettings type, use satisfies instead of as cast

findings.description: ProjectSettingsSchema allows unknown fields via Record<string, unknown> passthrough
findings.impact: Violates strict validation expectations of AC
findings.suggested_fix: Make settings schema strict, define explicit ProjectSettings type

findings.description: In-memory rate limiter Map never removes expired entries
findings.impact: Memory usage grows unbounded over time
findings.suggested_fix: Add periodic cleanup interval to remove expired entries

findings.description: Priority validation mismatch when value cleared to undefined
findings.impact: Minor UX confusion on edge case
findings.suggested_fix: Add typeof check and NaN guard

findings.description: handleDragEnd can throw on stale data without try-catch
findings.impact: Component crash during concurrent operations
findings.suggested_fix: Wrap in try-catch with finally { setActiveId(null) }

findings.description: Unnecessary type assertion on FEATURE_VALID_TRANSITIONS to Record<string, string[]>
findings.impact: Weakens type safety, masks refactoring errors
findings.suggested_fix: Remove the as assertion, use imported type directly

findings.description: Session router delete handler uses custom error handling instead of centralized handleRepositoryError
findings.impact: Inconsistent error handling across routers
findings.suggested_fix: Replace with handleRepositoryError(error, 'delete session')

findings.description: withTransaction method defined but never called
findings.impact: Dead code increases cognitive load
findings.suggested_fix: Remove or document with usage example

findings.description: AC says flexible settings but schema enforces exactly 4 fields
findings.impact: Ambiguous requirement interpretation
findings.suggested_fix: Clarify AC wording or allow extensible settings

findings.description: Cannot verify test coverage percentage without running test suite
findings.impact: AC coverage not fully verifiable via static analysis
findings.suggested_fix: Run tests with coverage reporting

findings.description: No retry on duplicate ID constraint violation (cascading from ISS-002)
findings.impact: Creates fail under race condition without recovery
findings.suggested_fix: Add retry with backoff on UNIQUE constraint error

findings.description: Health check SELECT 1 result not verified
findings.impact: Degraded DB may still report healthy
findings.suggested_fix: Check query result value

findings.description: statusColors Record duplicated in 2+ components
findings.impact: Maintenance burden when colors change
findings.suggested_fix: Extract to shared utility

findings.description: Plain console.error in production error interceptors
findings.impact: Not suitable for production observability
findings.suggested_fix: Use structured JSON logging

findings.description: JSON settings not validated by Zod at query time
findings.impact: Runtime data may not match expected shape
findings.suggested_fix: Add post-query Zod validation or use validateJson

findings.description: Rollback capability is manual restore only, not automated down migrations
findings.impact: AC wording implies more than what exists
findings.suggested_fix: Update AC to match actual implementation
